contexts.text: They who have been in goods and truths of faith, and have thence acquired conscience and life of charity, are elevated into Heaven by the Lord immediately after death.
The dominant principle of life... cannot be changed after death.
Man is such as his will is, and such he remains after death, because death is not the end of life, but its continuation.
Everyone comes after death into that Hell or into that Heaven in which he was in the world.
Man comes into angelic wisdom after the rejection of the body, that is, after death... DSS 75.
Everyone is tolerated among the good when he comes into the other life, which takes place immediately after death.
The life of man cannot be changed after death... NJHD 239. Illustrated.

Those who die adults have a plane acquired from the... material world... it serves their thought after death for an ultimate plane... Hence it is that such as that plane is, and such as is the correspondence of the Rational with what is therein, such is the man after death.
Every man's ruling affection or love remains with him after death, nor is it extirpated to eternity. Explained.
That man after death is in a perfect human form. General article.
That man after death is in all sense, memory, thought and affection, in which he was in the world... General article.
That man is after death as his life was in the world. General article.
That man after death is his own love or his own will. General article.
That man after death remains to eternity such as he is as to his will or reigning love. General article.
All, as soon as they come after death into the World of Spirits, are explored as to their quality, and are attached to those who are in similar love...
That the delights of every one's life are after death turned into corresponding delights. General article.
He who is in the science (of correspondences) may know his state after death, if only he knows his love...
On the first state of man after death. General article. HH 5M 4. General article.
There are some who do not pass through these states, but immediately after death are either taken up into Heaven or cast into Hell. Explained.
On the second state of man after death. General article.
On the third state of man after death... General article.
Repentance after death is not possible. From experience. LJ 25.
After the life of the body man rejects what does not agree with his love. CL 36:2.
All, of whatever religion, after death are first conducted to those whom they had worshipped in the world...
Every one after death is in a like life to that in which he had been in the world; this cannot be changed...
Every one after death retains his religiosity that he had imbued in the world...
Man is equally man after death, and is so completely man that he is not aware of his having left the former world... TCR 160:7. TCR 607:end. Explained.
To go to them that sell, and buy oil = to procure good of love from others after death. AE 252:end.
Every man after death is instructed by Angels, and they who see truths are received... for it is given to every one to see truths spiritually after death...
After death man himself casts out those things (knowledges that are without life) because they do not agree with the love of his will.
When everything that is on the outside is put off, as takes place after death, then an evil man first of all casts out truth his friend in the world...

Such a man after death, although he has not committed murders, adulteries, etc., still hankers to commit them, and also does so, when the external... is taken away. All concupiscence remains with man after death... But they who do not will to commit murder, adultery, etc... these after death, when the external... is taken away, act as one with Heaven.
They who live (according to the precepts they have) from religion, receive truths when instructed by Angels after death.
If a man abstains from adulteries (from merely external reasons) he commits them in spirit... wherefore after death, when he becomes a Spirit, he openly speaks in favour of them.

He who loves the neighbour from charity conjoins himself with his good and not with his person, except in so far and so long as he is in good... but he who loves another from mere friendship, conjoins himself with his person, and at the same time with his evil; after death the latter can hardly be separated from the person which is in evil. See TCR 446.

Many... who have looked to the Lord in their life, and have avoided evils from religion, but have been withheld from thinking about truths by worldly cares and business, and also by lack of truth with those who teach... after death, when they become Spirits, and are instructed by Angels, acknowledge truths and receive them with joy.
They who... remain natural... after death become menials and servants...

The natural man with whom the spiritual degree has been opened does not know that his spiritual mind is filled by the Lord with thousands of arcana of wisdom, and with thousands of delights of love, and that he will come into them after death, when he becomes an Angel. Explained.

The lot after death of those with whom the spiritual degree has not been opened, and yet has not been closed up is that they are in the lowest parts of Heaven, where they sometimes suffer hard things.
The mind is the man himself, for the primary texture of the human form... is from first principles from the brain continued through the nerves... it is this form into which man comes after death...
Most are in the Spiritual World two days after (the death of the body).
All the understanding that is above man's own proper love is removed after death.

In the world, man can hardly come into the conjunction... of good and truth, or of evil and falsity, ... but every man comes into one or the other after death, because he can then no longer be reformed and regenerated... DP 329.
Man is in the spiritual degree of wisdom after death...

The adult who does not come into freedom itself and rationality itself in the world, can never come into them after death, for then the state of his life remains to eternity such as it had been in the world.
Hence man does not know his lot after death.

Devils... when in a state of wisdom laughed at insanity, and when in a state of insanity laughed at wisdom. A man who has been such in the world, after death when he becomes a Spirit is for the most part let into alternate states of wisdom and insanity, in order that he may see the latter from the former.
The life's love, which is also the reigning love, remains with everyone after death, and cannot be taken away. CL 34. General article.
a. If evil is not removed in the world it cannot be removed afterwards... The ultimates of life which man takes with him after death are quiescent...

a. [end]. If a man is in an infernal Society he can only be brought out of it by the Lord according to the laws of His Divine Providence, among which is this, that the man should see that he is there, and will to come out, and should endeavour to do so from himself; this a man can do while he is in the world, but not after death, for he then remains to eternity in the Society into which he had inserted himself in the world. DP 307:2.
So long as he lives in the world an evil man does not feel the bonds with which he is tied round... but after death these bonds become hard and stinging.
They who deny God in the world deny him after death.
There is given to every man after death an opportunity of amending his life if possible...
Foreseeing and providing every one's place after death.
All truth is sown in the inward man and rooted in the outward: this root the man who has done truths bears with him after death, but not the man who has known and acknowledged them with faith alone.
The state after death of those who come into the other life. Described, Signified.
Everyone after death comes into his own place.
Every man who has longed for Heaven, and has had fixed ideas about the joys there, is introduced after death into the joys of his imagination.
The state of a man who conjoins himself with the Lord through a life according to His precepts is more blessed and happy after death than before it. Explained.
After death, man is not his own thought, but his own affection and thought thence derived.
On the state of married partners after death. General article. DeConj 50. General article.
That the love of the sex remains with every man after death such as it had been inwardly... in the world. General article.

Every love follows a man after death, because it is the esse of his life, and the reigning love, which is the head of the rest, remains with every man to eternity, and with it all the subordinate loves. Explained.
a. [3]. Every man after death becomes such as he has been inwardly...
The putting off of the external and the putting on of the internal after death described.
All married partners who are merely natural are separated after death. Explained. CL 320.
Married partners of whom one is spiritual and the other natural are also separated after death...
To everyone after death is imputed the evil in which he is; in like manner the good. General article. BE 110.
That the life of everyone remains with him after death. Explained. BE 110:2.
Every man after death lays aside the Natural that he took from the mother, and retains the Spiritual... from the father, together with a certain limbus around it from the purest things of nature...
After departure from the world no one is able to believe anything except what he has impressed upon himself through confirmation...
Every man after death comes into the World of Spirits, and then seems to himself to be just like what he was before. (His first experience there described.)
The states of men after death (described in succession). AR 153.
Friendship of love tied with a man without regard to his spiritual quality is detrimental after death. General article.
The door (between thought and speech) is opened with everyone after death, and then his quality appears.

The man who in the world has commenced the first state (reformation), can after death be introduced into the second (regeneration), but he who has not entered into the first state in the world cannot after death be introduced into the second.
That there is no repentance or reformation after death. SE 3048.
On the states of souls after death. SE 690. SE 782. SE 815. SE 885. SE 1103. SE 1117. SE 2030. SE 3502.
(State of a lady for four or five weeks after death.) SE 4160.
(Swedenborg speaks with Er. Broman on the third day after death.)
On the fourth day after death he was called to judgment...
That the nature of man after death cannot be taken away, but may be broken and subdued.
(Why man cannot change after death.)
After death the good are not let into their evils, but the evil are.
All men are after death turned to their own loves... References.
It is the state of thought from the spirit, and not that from the memory that remains after death.
That only remains with man after death which is of his love...
The delights of life remain with everyone after death.
Such are deprived of all knowledge of good and truth after death. Signified.
Impossibility of receiving faith after death.
Man's state as to will or love is not changed after death... but his state as to understanding is changed...
